hooks.logic:
Let v be a last-move sequence {}.
Let currentParamId be the enemy → get-current-param-id.
Let suffixNoByParamId be the enemy → get-suffix-no-by-param-id with (currentParamId).
If suffixNoByParamId is not "3", then
  If suffixNoByParamId is "1", then
    Set v to v → concat with ([[{deformTag: "deformation_01", shouldDeformAllNodes: false}]]).
    Queue the pose-change sequence v.
    Queue the move {abilityTag: "hell_biter"}.
    Set v to [].
  Set v to v → concat with ([[{deformTag: "deformation_03", shouldDeformAllNodes: false}]]).
  Queue the pose-change sequence v.
  Put queued moves ahead of counters.

script_hooks.logic:
Count up "turnForHellbiter".
Set the next state to nothing.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If the count "turnForHellbiter" is at least the numeric entry "period_of_turn_of_hellbiter" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then
    Set the next state to 30.
    Reset the count "turnForHellbiter".
  Otherwise
    Let ability be a weighted random move of the enemy.
    If ability is the id of the move labelled "over_death" on the enemy, then set the next state to if call helper2 then 40 else 41.
    Otherwise, if ability is the id of the move labelled "holy" on the enemy, then set the next state to if call helper then 50 else 51.
    Otherwise, the enemy uses ability.
